periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented inward toward the rostrum at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Moderate downward tapering toward the muzzle, creating an asymmetrical teardrop effect.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness where the band meets the lateral shoulder junction.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and semicircular top boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark punctate markings or debris on the white pelage of the nasal bridge.
